title: Psychology Facts
hook: What happens when you get 24 choices instead of 6?
facts: In a famous 2000 jam study, shoppers saw either *24 jams* or *6*.
The big table drew more visitors. But far fewer *bought*.
About *3%* bought from 24 jams. About *30%* from 6.
Later studies found the effect is *smaller*, but too many options can still freeze us.
